props.headline: Questions come up on the first tee.
props.emphasis: The answer should not wait for the clubhouse.
props.body: Members ask when it matters to them. A club that answers in that moment feels easy to belong to.

caption:
Questions come up on the first tee, not at the desk.

Is the grill open after the round? What is the guest policy on Sunday? Members ask when the answer matters to them, which is rarely when the club sent the notice.

A club that can answer in that moment is a club members find easy to belong to.
firstComment: Most of these questions have published answers. The gap is getting the answer to the member while they are still standing there.
altText: Photograph of a golfer on the course on a clear day, with the headline: Questions come up on the first tee. The answer should not wait for the clubhouse.
earnsItsPlace: Frames the member's question at the moment it arises on the course, which is the moment Club Pilot's answers reach members; a course or apparel brand has no stake in that gap.
